name: Pastoral Care
overview: Scripture reveals pastoral care as a sacred responsibility modeled by the Lord as the Good Shepherd who provides and protects His flock, as seen in Psalms 23:1 and Ezekiel 34:2. True shepherds are called to selflessly feed and care for the flock, reflecting Christ's own love and sacrifice, emphasized in John 21:15 and Acts 20:28. This care extends beyond mere oversight to active love and service toward others, fulfilling Christ's command to love one another as He has loved us (John 13:34) and meeting the practical needs of the hungry, thirsty, and stranger (Matthew 25:35).
